why_gradient_is_demoted: The completed masked seen panel retained at least one non-gradient beneficial candidate in all six queries.
Projected gradient was beneficial in 3/5 available queries but oracle-best in 0/5.
Removing gradient reduces candidate-truth branches and online autograd without removing observed seen-query beneficial coverage.
Because removing gradient changes pi0 continuation, old four-family exact returns remain mechanism evidence only and are not reused as new three-family training labels.
current_response: Retain five added Storage nodes, frozen Step1 and frozen 109-channel base Step2.
Keep 82 native supervisory controls and 27 passive setting channels with the existing masked q95 support.
Use only Step2 H10 0.50, Step2 H10 1.00 and type-aware hydraulic-pressure as current candidate families.
Keep projected gradient available only for explicit Development ablation and exclude it from current pi0, pi1 and matched calibration.
Train a receding-policy-return critic on same-prefix authoritative SWMM labels; default adaptation remains control/action heads rather than full-model retraining.
Before bulk labels, inventory existing untouched forcing metadata without SWMM, then create only the forcing deficit needed for role-disjoint 48/12/24/3 assignments.
After this portfolio change, run a minimal new three-family mechanism confirmation under its own pi0 continuation before bulk label generation.
